identity: RW tempo-burn-aggro deck built around Zealous Conscripts as the closing payoff: efficient cheap beaters and a dense removal/burn suite (Lightning Axe, Fiery Temper, Abrade, Vexing Devil, Chandra Dressed to Kill) clear blockers and apply reach, then Zealous Conscripts steals the opponent's best remaining blocker and swings with haste for the win.
